_doc: Write p99 at 16 vCPU (double the 8-vCPU run), SAME load: 1,000,000 streams, combined stack, single fixed rung (32 pool pods = 8192 connections). Compares directly against run-durable-cpu8-1m-p99-combined (which hit p50=2.9/p99=80ms @ 86% of 8 cores, 454k ops/s). Does doubling cores drop the tail / lift throughput at the same offered load? NO ladder. 60s measure. Image = durable-streams:combined @ f04baa64e. SERVER_CPUS=16 on c4d-standard-16-lssd, --wal-shards 16 --worker-threads 16. NO --wal-stats (would perturb the tail). Client fleet: 5x n2d-standard-32 (huge headroom for 32 pods).
